heroHeadline: Ceuta Erupts in First Violent Clashes: Soldiers Ambushed, Red Cross Blocked, Migrant Camp Burned
heroSubtitle: A month-long standoff turns violent as Ceuta residents block a Red Cross food truck for two hours, then break through a police cordon to storm and set fire to migrants' shelters on Trampolín/Benítez beach; hours earlier, roughly 70 migrants ambushed and stoned a military vehicle in Benzú, injuring one soldier and prompting 12 arrests. Madrid responds by creating a 'single command' under Minister Ángel Víctor Torres to coordinate five ministries and approving €25 million more for unaccompanied minors, but Ceuta's finance councillor says tension in the city is 'very high' amid accusations the national government has been too slow to act.
